observations.error: permission fixture HTTP failure; no replay
observations.resolution: The test client sent modern metadata without matching HTTP protocol/method/name headers. Fixed the client, not the server.

A concurrent loser may encounter consumed permission or a changed prepared-file baseline. Both are bounded no-write rejections; require exactly one winner plus a subsequent sequential permission denial.
Replacing a line invalidated the same patch after success. Insert after a permanent unique anchor so rechallenge measures grant consumption rather than failed hunk matching.

limits: Pilot used a directly selected reviewed artifact. Formatting/test edits occurred during development, so these observations are not a sealed clean-source qualification. The subsequent post-commit qualifier must bind source and artifact independently.
